# What `serve/server.py` does

`serve/server.py` is the HTTP API layer of the Strata project (plan v0.3 P8). It is the bridge between OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible clients and the C++ inference engine, and it is deliberately model-free: it never touches tensors or the GPU. Its responsibilities are:

1. **Engine lifecycle.** `StrataEngine` keeps one `strata --serve` process resident (weights, expert arena, VRAM tier load once) and talks to it over a stdin/stdout line protocol (`GEN <max_new> [sampling keys] <ids>` in, `T <id>` / `PP ...` / `DONE ...` out). It restarts a dead engine (`restart()`), unloads it on idle (`unload()`), and `narrate_start()` prints human-readable progress while the engine loads tens of GB, because the PC can freeze for minutes and users otherwise close the window. `Vision` does the same for the `strata-vision` image encoder, with a hash-keyed on-disk cache so a picture sent every turn is encoded once. `MockEngine` is a scripted stand-in that makes every API path testable without a GPU.
